items.text:
Ok, so there’s an ambitious sandbox game hiding here, with a full solar system to explore tucked behind a scroll-wheel zoom level. Seems like you can grow from a poor shipbreaker into a fleet owner and planetary resident.

I can’t say how much of that is actually implemented, because I’m still at the starter shipbreaking location. But...

From the early gameplay, it feels like the dev just gave up on finishing this game. The current systems are still pretty much placeholders or outright broken.

Especially the task system, which is just plain ♥♥♥♥-code (I’m sorry, but there’s no nicer way to put it). Most of the shipbreaking and shipbuilding currently plays like an idler at 16x speed, with periodic pauses to babysit the characters. Babysitting is required because the AI priority system is braindead and gets stuck in loops. Characters can’t grab stuff, drop stuff, or put stuff into things. Instead, they just walk between locations, endlessly failing tasks until you notice and sort out their inventory or pathfinding.

Hauling stuff is silly too. There’s no planning ahead, so characters carry only one item at a time. But fine, I can live with that. What I can’t live with is when it breaks in a way I can’t manually fix. My current save just went in the trash because I can’t recharge tools anymore. In autotask mode, the character now gets stuck trying and failing to insert a battery into an empty charger. I think the game considers the slots occupied, so the character just drops the battery on the floor.

But ok, playing an idler at 16x isn’t fun, right? Why not control the player manually and play a sim? Oh, because then you can only do one thing at a time. The task system doesn’t work at all with manual actions. You can’t queue up two walls for deconstruction; you have to wait for each action to finish before starting the next. Still at 16x speed, btw, because otherwise a repair can take 10 minutes of real time.

I know it’s supposed to be a masochistic space engineering sim, but all in all, it’s just a bad game. The dev just doesn’t know how to code.

Cool idea though.
items.text_zh:
好吧，所以这里隐藏着一个雄心勃勃的沙盒游戏，有一个完整的太阳系可以探索，藏在滚轮缩放级别后面。看起来你可以从一个贫穷的拆船工成长为舰队所有者和行星居民。

我无法说这些有多少是真正实现了的，因为我还待在起始的拆船地点。但是……

从早期的游戏体验来看，感觉开发者只是放弃完成这个游戏了。当前的系统基本上还是占位符或者干脆就是坏的。

尤其是任务系统，简直就是纯粹的♥♥♥♥代码（抱歉，但没有更委婉的说法了）。目前大部分的拆船和造船玩起来就像是一个16倍速的放置游戏，时不时要暂停来照看角色。需要照看是因为AI优先级系统蠢得要命，会卡在循环里。角色不能抓东西、丢东西，或者把东西放进东西里。相反，他们只是在地点之间走来走去，无休止地失败任务，直到你注意到并整理他们的物品栏或寻路。

搬运东西也很蠢。没有提前规划，所以角色一次只携带一件物品。但好吧，这个我能忍。我不能忍的是它以我无法手动修复的方式坏掉。我当前的存档刚刚进了垃圾桶，因为我再也不能给工具充电了。在自动任务模式下，角色现在会卡住，试图把电池插入一个空的充电器但一直失败。我觉得游戏认为插槽已被占用，所以角色就把电池丢在地上了。

但是好吧，以16倍速玩放置游戏不好玩，对吧？为什么不手动控制玩家来玩模拟呢？哦，因为那样你一次只能做一件事。任务系统在手动操作下完全不起作用。你不能排队拆除两堵墙；你必须等每个动作完成才能开始下一个。顺便说一下，还是16倍速，因为否则一次修理可能要花10分钟现实时间。

我知道这应该是一个受虐狂式的太空工程模拟，但总而言之，它就是一个糟糕的游戏。开发者就是不知道怎么编程。

不过想法很酷。
